messages:
Avery P: Quick planning thread 1) bundle for Datadog marketplace: OTEL collector config, span naming guide, dashboard templates, and a short troubleshooting note.
Rina S: I'd add a one-page integration checklist for SI partners (what logs/traces to expect, sample queries).
Avery P: Good call. Checklist items: enable OTLP exporter, set service.name, set env tag, ensure egress to Datadog endpoint, and enable DD_TRACE_ANALYTICS if high throughput.
Omar K: For span naming, let's avoid overloading names. Proposal: `redwood.request`, `redwood.model.exec`, `redwood.storage.kv_hit`, `redwood.storage.kv_miss`, `redwood.batch.flush`. Short and consistent.
Rina S: Agree. Also document attribute naming: `model.name`, `model.version`, `gpu.uuid`, `batch.size`, `tokens.generated`.
Avery P: I made a tiny OTEL collector snippet we can ship as "drop-in" for Private customers. Paste below: 
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DATADOG_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Omar K: Nice. Add network hint for Private: use proxy to route to Datadog or a VPC NAT egress. And call out firewall ports (443).
datadog-bot: FYI: Datadog marketplace team requires screenshots + sample dashboard JSON. Partner review turnaround ~5 business days.
Rina S: For dashboards we'll provide three presets: "Latency (chat)", "Throughput (batch)", "Infra (GPU & Cost)". Each will include recommended queries and variable placeholders.
Avery P: Example query for latency widget: `avg:trace.redwood.model.exec.duration{env:$env,service:$service} by {model.name}`. For prefix cache hits: `sum:trace.redwood.storage.kv_hit{*} by {service}`.
Omar K: Let's also include a tiny eval script partners can run to generate test traces: a Python snippet that calls the SDK and emits spans. I'll draft one.
Rina S: Who owns the partner docs write-up? I can take marketplace copy + screenshots. Avery can bundle OTEL snippets + collector config. Omar owns sample trace generator and span mapping doc.
Avery P: Timeline: draft assets by next Wed (1785665923). Internal review Thu, ship to Datadog Fri.
Rina S: Add a short troubleshooting FAQ: missing spans -> check exporter, ensure service.name, check sampling settings, check TLS/proxy.
Avery P: Will include that. Also tagging: map OTEL resource `deployment.environment` -> tag `env`, `telemetry.sdk.version` -> `otel.sdk_version`.
datadog-bot: Note: marketplace submission form requires a contact email and an OAuth client ID if using advanced integration features.
Omar K: One more: include a note for Dedicated customers to enable GPU metrics exporter (nvidia-smi integration) so dashboards show utilization.
Avery P: Perfect. I'll post a Google Drive folder link when assets are ready. Drop any widget snippets here if you want them included. :thumbsup:
